name: Generic 5-port router (front-panel ports and status lights)
build: blender -b --factory-startup --python source/build_router_generic.py, then glTF-Transform dedup → weld → meshopt
units: metres; origin at the centre of the base; front faces +Z in three.js
lod: one level: 10.7k triangles holds up from wide shot to a 12 cm close-up; add LODs only when a scene shows many
textures: none: Principled BSDF → glTF metallic-roughness; printed legends are geometry

anchors.port_lan1: LAN port 1, centre of the opening, on the face
anchors.led_wan: link light of the WAN port

front: status lights with icons: POWER, INTERNET, WI-FI, LAN
LAN 1–4 (RJ45, latch notch down, per-port link light above)

behaviour: generic; see ../../../README.md § LED states. Not the behaviour of any specific model.
matches_2d: videos/_engine/lib/devices2.mjs router2 — same layout at 0.53 mm per drawing unit, for a silhouette-matched hand-over

provenance.origin: original work, authored for OE by the explainer engine (procedural Blender script)
provenance.creator: OE Support explainer engine
provenance.license: OE-owned; no third-party geometry, textures or trademarks
provenance.fonts: DM Mono (SIL Open Font License 1.1) for printed legends — shared/fonts/OFL-DMMono.txt
